info.title: past.dev Memory API
info.summary: Ingest timestamped text and retrieve ranked, source-backed memory.
info.description: The memory endpoints of the past.dev API, copied from https://past.dev/openapi.json. This is an unofficial guide; the source of truth is past.dev/docs.

post.description: Accept one timestamped source. Returns 202 when processing is queued or 200 when the source is unchanged.

200.description: Nothing to process: content, label, metadata and timestamp all match what is stored for the id, or only the audience moved. Nothing is charged, and the receipt carries status completed and unchanged true.

202.description: The source was accepted and processing was queued.

400.description: The request is malformed or violates a field constraint. Match behavior on the response code field.

401.description: missing-api-key: no bearer. malformed-api-key: the header or the key has the wrong shape, or an agent token was sent to a route that accepts keys only. unauthorized: the key is unknown, expired, revoked, or of the kind this route refuses, or the agent token is invalid or expired.

402.description: out-of-credits: the organization's credits are spent. `data` carries `creditsLeft`, `creditsNeeded` and `resetsOn`. Do not retry: buy credits, or wait for `resetsOn`.

403.description: project-archived: the project of the key, or the project an agent token names, is archived. Unarchive it in the console to resume. insufficient-scope: the agent token does not carry the scope of the route.

409.description: The idempotency key was already used with another payload.

413.description: content-too-large: the content exceeds 16 MiB of UTF-8.

429.description: The project's monthly cap (project-cap-reached) or the account's spend cap for the billing period (spend-cap-reached) is reached, or the plan's requests per minute are exceeded. The per-minute refusal carries no body.

503.description: The organization is not ready or background ingestion is disabled.

default.description: Any other failure uses the same JSON error envelope.

402.description: out-of-credits: the recall costs 1 credit and the balance cannot pay for it. Every recall costs 1 credit on Pay as you go; on Flex and Enterprise a recall costs nothing within fair use and 1 credit above it, and only above it is it refused for credits. `data` carries `creditsLeft`, `creditsNeeded` and `resetsOn`. Do not retry: buy credits, or wait for `resetsOn`.

429.description: The plan's requests per minute are exceeded, which carries no body, or `spend-cap-reached` where the recall is priced and the billing period's spend cap is reached. No plan caps the number of recall calls.

default.description: Any other failure uses the same JSON error envelope.

bearerAuth.description: Project API key beginning with past_sk_.

managementKeyAuth.description: Management key beginning with past_mk_. One per organization, created from Settings in the console.

agentTokenAuth.description: Agent access token for one person, issued by https://sso.past.dev after the person approves the agent. https://api.past.dev/auth.md gives the procedure. The operation names the scope it asks for: memory:read or memory:write. Send X-Past-Project with the project slug; without it, the only live project of the organization is used, and an organization with two or more returns 400 project-required. Managed service only.

RequestId.description: Server-generated id of this call, beginning with req_. Present on every /api/v1 response. The console's Requests screen lists the call under it.

status.description: HTTP status repeated in the body.

content.description: Raw text. Empty or whitespace-only content is refused.

label.description: Optional short title for the data point, stored as its own field and returned as label on recall sources. Omitted on a re-send, the stored label stays.

id.description: Stable source id, with no '/' in it. When omitted, the lowercase SHA-256 of content is used.

timestamp.description: When the content occurred. Stored at microsecond precision.

metadata.description: Optional caller JSON stored with the source.

audience.description: Audience slug. Omit it or send project for project-visible memory.

identity.description: Customer id for the author. Its first ingest appearance creates the directory record.

content.description: Raw text. Empty or whitespace-only content is refused.

label.description: Optional short title for the data point, stored as its own field and returned as label on recall sources. Omitted on a re-send, the stored label stays.

id.description: Stable source id, with no '/' in it. When omitted, the lowercase SHA-256 of content is used.

timestamp.description: When the content occurred. Stored at microsecond precision.

metadata.description: Optional caller JSON stored with the source.

audience.description: Audience slug. Omit it or send project for project-visible memory.

identity.description: Customer id for the author. Its first ingest appearance creates the directory record.

idempotencyKey.description: Replay key for the complete batch.

eventId.description: The id of the event, beginning with evt_, assigned at receipt.

requestId.description: The id of this call, as in the X-Request-Id header.

droppedBy.description: On a dropped event: the first filter that did not match, or the missing content. Null on an ingested event.

ingestionId.description: The ingestion id of an ingested event, read with the ingestion status operation. Null on a dropped event.

dataPointId.description: The source id of the data point: the mapped id, or the event id when the webhook maps none. Null on a dropped event.

unchanged.description: True when the event repeats a data point whose content and time are unchanged.

status.description: This send. Poll until completed. failed means the send stopped on an error: failure names the reason, and POST /api/v1/ingest/{ingestionId}/retry runs it again.

failure.description: Why a failed send stopped. Null for every other status.

limit.description: Maximum number of documents in the page.

level.description: The evidence budget in words: low 8,000 tokens, medium 16,000, high 24,000, extra-high 32,000. A level above the plan's ceiling is lowered to it: 8,000 on Pay as you go and Flex, 32,000 on Enterprise. Send level or maxTokens, never both.

maxTokens.description: An explicit evidence budget in tokens, for a caller who needs a figure the levels do not offer. Estimated from document content and excerpt text only, excluding JSON structure and metadata; lowered to the plan's ceiling in the same way; whole documents are kept or omitted.

queryTimestamp.description: The perspective of the read. Evidence at or before this instant is eligible. Defaults to now.

occurredFrom.description: Inclusive start of the occurrence window.

occurredTo.description: Inclusive end of the occurrence window. A start after the end returns 400 recall-range-invalid.

sort.description: chronological orders the selected documents oldest first and keeps each relevance rank.

RecallSource.description: Evidence for this document grouped by canonical source id and date; not the artifact's complete provenance. Original source documents have no duplicated body in excerpts.

metadata.description: Caller metadata, exactly as sent; omitted when none was sent. Untrusted descriptive context.

label.description: The caller's label for the source, as sent at ingest; omitted when none was sent.

excerpts.description: Verbatim supporting quotations. Repeated quotations are preserved.

kind.description: source is an original data point. Any other value is the kind of a derived memory: observation, claim, rule, membership, identity, mention or temporal-anchor. The list can grow; treat an unknown value as a memory. The Concepts page of the docs defines each kind.

supersededAt.description: Present when a later statement readable by this viewer superseded the artifact.

usedEvidenceTokens.description: Sum of per-document character-based estimates for content and excerpt text only; excludes JSON structure, IDs, dates and metadata. Not model-provider usage.

RecallPending.description: Present only while ingestions of the project are still processing. Their memory is not in this recall yet.

ingestions.description: Ingestions accepted and not yet complete or failed.

dataPoints.description: The data points those ingestions carry.

since.description: When the oldest of them was accepted.

message.description: One sentence for a person or an agent. The wording can change; read the numbers.

audiences.description: The audience slugs the identity reaches, on the single-record read; null elsewhere.

ids.description: Caller-owned source ids. Repeated ids count once.

operationId.description: The background deletion this request started.

ids.description: The distinct ids covered, in the order named.

values.description: One value for is and is_not, 1 to 50 for is_one_of and is_not_one_of, none for exists and does_not_exist.

name.description: Defaults to the slug on create.

identities.description: Required for a fixed audience. An empty list reaches nobody. An id with no record is created.

memberCount.description: The identities the audience reaches now.

memoryCount.description: The memories scoped to this audience.

reachesNobody.description: True for a rule audience that matches no identity.

identities.description: The ids of a fixed audience, sorted. Null for the other kinds.

rule.description: The rule of a rule audience. Null for the other kinds.

name.description: Display name with at least two letters or digits. The slug is derived from it.

ingestionCap.description: The project's monthly data-point cap. Null when the project carries none.

monthIngestions.description: Data points accepted this calendar month.

creditCap.description: The project's monthly credit cap. Null when the project carries none.

id.description: The key id, used to revoke it.

key.description: The clear value. Returned in this response and nowhere else.

code.description: Why the send stopped. content-rejected is the one reason a retry does not fix.

message.description: The same reason in one sentence.

path.description: The path inside the import. Its extension helps detection.

content.description: The file as text. Extract PDF or office text yourself first.

kind.description: Read the file as this kind instead of detecting it.

files.description: The files to cut. Send files or items, never both and never neither.

items.description: Data points you cut yourself, batched and priced as given.

timeZone.description: IANA zone reading the times a file writes without one. UTC when omitted.

points.description: How much of each point the answer lists.

kind.description: The kind the file was read as. Null for a skipped file.

detectedBy.description: The rule that decided the kind, for example extension .md.

skipped.description: Why the file was left out, when it was.

from.description: The first point's position in the cut.

to.description: The last point's position in the cut.

idempotencyKey.description: Send the batch with this key so a retry never doubles a point.

id.description: The stable source id the point will be sent under.

path.description: The file the point came from.

preview.description: The first 160 characters of the content.

content.description: With points full only: the content to send. Null otherwise.

metadata.description: With points full only: the metadata the cut recorded. Null otherwise.

left.description: The credits the account may still draw. Null with no plan.

resetsAt.description: Null where the credits never reset.

projectCapLeft.description: This project's credit cap left. Null with no credit cap.

pointsOmitted.description: The points past the listing cap.

fits.description: Whether the whole import fits what is left to spend.

fitsFirst.description: How many points, in time order, do fit.

metered.description: False on a deployment with no plan.

searchable.description: Whether the text you sent can be recalled yet.

memories.description: The memories drawn from this revision that are current and searchable.

sourceId.description: The id the lineage read takes as a root.

ingestionId.description: Null for a call refused before a send existed.

status.description: The status the call answered, while the log holds it.

failure.description: Present only when the phase is failed.

items.description: The first 100 data points the send carried.

next.description: One sentence naming the step to take.

retryable.description: False only for content-rejected: the content has to change first.

prefix.description: The key's display prefix. Never anything of the secret.

outcome.description: What the call did, in the console's words.

phase.description: Where the send this call started got to.

headers.description: The allowlisted request headers. Never Authorization.

request.description: The stored request body as JSON, or its text when it does not parse.

response.description: The stored response body as JSON, or its text when it does not parse.

payloadExpired.description: True once the plan's payload retention has passed.

payloadRetentionDays.description: The plan's payload retention window. Null where payloads are kept.

failedLater.description: Calls the platform accepted and then stopped on.

memoryKind.description: The kind of the memory, as artifact.kind on a recall result: observation, claim, rule, membership, identity, mention or temporal-anchor. Null for a source.

content.description: A source's text, cut to 4,000 characters.

hiddenCount.description: How many nodes the limit left out.

section.description: The first section that claims the node.

resetsAt.description: Null with no plan, and where the credits never reset.

rolledOver.description: Unused included credits carried from earlier months.

credits.description: Credits this project spent this month. Null with no plan.

balance.description: Null on a deployment with no plan.

projects.description: With the management key: every live project, heaviest spender first.
